_comment: Default/starter rules. Once your database is connected, edit everything from the web dashboard at /admin instead of this file. Structure: defaultCommentRules & defaultDmRules apply everywhere; categories are named rule-sets you can assign to posts; postAssignments maps a specific post/reel ID to a category or its own custom rules.
